categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including ownership details, parcel numbers, extents, and legal encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related matters.
